notes: Hand poses: the right hand holds the pipette with the handle pinch of the earlier run (handle_pinch_pose + optimize_pose_for_reach), re-anchored with subgoal.reanchor_pose, with press_depth_rad 0 (poses/right_pipette_p0.json: the fingers stop at contact; the 0.12 rad squeeze pushed the leaning pipette and the light rack about 1 cm and made the Stage 4 physics replay lose the tip mount); the left hand holds the tube with the generate_rigid_grasps thumb-index pinch near its rim (press_depth_rad 0). Both pass grasp_stress_test in their hand scenes (re-run with the current library).

Pipette out of its well (2.1): the pipette leans 14 deg in the rack's end well with its nose in the catch hole, so it is lifted along its own axis with a 3 mm side step away from the hole edge (lift_path) instead of straight up; a straight lift dragged the light rack.

Tip mount (3.3): the nose is pressed 10.5 mm into the free tip's collar (height_m -0.0105 under the collar top: the 7.5 mm seat plus 3 mm). The earlier plan's 44 mm press slid the pipette 34 mm through the pinch once the tip bottomed. The tip snaps on and rides the 6.5 cm lift (3.4); measured at 68.6 mm below the pipette's root along its axis.

Draw (4.x) and dispense (5.x): the tip is dipped straight down (pipette upright, yaw kept as the hand holds it) into the rack tube (3.3 cm deep) and into the held tube (1.65 cm deep). For the dispense the left hand first brings the tube to the middle of the table (5.1, the right arm cannot reach the tube where it was parked during the tip mount), then the two-hand step (5.3) runs the right hand's dip while the left hand holds the tube still. A deeper dip (3.4 cm) brought the right palm into the left forearm (arm collision 12 mm).

Plunger strokes are not executed: the Stage 1 goal sentences of subgoals 4 and 5 state intended outcomes (liquid drawn / dispensed) that cannot be seen; the executor has no thumb-stroke motion while the same hand keeps its grip, and the goal gate asks for the tip inside each tube (goal_predicates insertion_depth over the dip entry).

Tube back (6.3): lowered 5 cm into well 1 by the rack's current pose (over the rack with the well's offset) and released 1.4 cm above the bottom plate; released from the top plate (into) it fell 7 cm and tunnelled into the 4 mm bottom plate.

Pipette down (7.x): the pipette is turned 90 deg about the table's y axis (handle away from the rack, nose toward it), rolled 45 deg about its own axis so the thumb and fingers sit at its sides, and yawed 20 deg (the right arm reaches the low horizontal pose only so), lowered flat until its axis is about 28 mm above the cloth (15 mm above its resting height) and released; it lands on its body, horizontal, and the mounted tip never touches the cloth. The earlier nose-down lay-down (turned about the table's x axis, fingers under the handle) landed on the tip's end and levered the tip 4.4 cm off the nose (contactless motion and teleport audits).

Order and hands as Stage 1: left tube out, right pipette out, tip, draw, dispense with both hands, tube back, pipette down. Extra steps inside subgoals (carries between actions, the tube brought to the middle before the dispense) carry their Stage 1 index.

Stage 4 config (py/package.sh patches what write_stage4_config writes): the mounted tip gets carrier right and release '#7.4' (it rides the pipette from the mount to the lay-down; carriers come only from phases that name an object and the tip travels as the pipette's 'with' companion); the pipette's rests_on (inferred from final contacts as the tip on its own nose) is dropped so it rests on the world like the tip; the right hand stays in the tip's frame through the lift off the box and the move away (3.4, 4.1: the tip rides the hand only from a frame anchored to it) and is anchored to the world for the dip into the held tube (5.2-6.1: the tube rides the world-anchored left hand there, while Stage 4 moves a hand anchored to an object with that object's start displacement).
